name: Terry Farms U-Pick
description: Terry Farms U-Pick is an u-pick farm in Madison, FL. Visitors come for Squash, Corn, Peppers, and Peas, best in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
